steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Good morning, Evie.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Good morning. It's a pleasure to meet you. I look forward to working... Oh, sorry, force of habit. I didn't mean to imply that I'm glad to take up your precious morning work hours...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Laugh it off and reassure her

choices.text: Laugh it off and reassure her

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There's no need to be so tense, Evie. I won't bite. You can relax a little.

Evie nods along obediently, but her body remains stiff as a board, her face completely pale. Well, that's to be expected. To her, an MBCC Interrogation is about as far removed from everyday life as Phanuel's speech at that concert.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How about this—let's start by going over some basic information. It'll help you ease into things. Could you tell me a bit about yourself? I'd like to cross-reference it with what we have on file.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Of course. My name is Evie. I'm 25... wait, no, 26 years old. Female. I work in the marketing department of a cosmetics company in Eastside. I was born in Eastside, both my parents are still alive, and my bank balance is...

She's remarkably cooperative, and doesn't hide a single thing about herself. The moment you stop her, she simply closes her mouth. Among all the people you've interrogated, she ranks among the most compliant—and most oblivious—of ordinary civilians.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you for your cooperation. I can see that you are a perfectly upstanding, model citizen of Eastside. Now then, Evie. Do you know why someone with a clean record like yours would end up sitting here?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: ...Is it because of an abnormal fluctuation in my M-value?
She sounds like a student who's suddenly been picked to answer a question in class. You correct her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: To be precise, it's because those fluctuations have been affecting your body. Although minor, our monitoring equipment did pick up signs of your power going berserk multiple times. That is what made MBCC's intervention mandatory.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Really...?! I'm... I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to cause anyone any trouble.

She nearly springs out of the interrogation chair, but the momentum doesn't carry her through the apology. She stops mid-sentence, presses a hand to her chest, and takes a long moment to steady herself before finishing.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: The thing is, I really didn't feel any issues with my health, or, well, my power going berserk... I mean, I eat just fine, sleep just fine, and my performance at work is... perfectly normal too. I'm doing perfectly well...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't need to hide how you're really feeling out of fear of being a burden. Your dark circles and those dizzy spells speak louder than anything. Besides, even if it isn't your condition that's causing this, we'll need to find the real reason behind your M-value fluctuations either way. I hope you can understand.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Sorry about that... I guess people like us are just too used to being subhealthy. Though I guess if anything has changed about my daily routine... it'd be that I've started actively using my <color=#fb9259>power</color>...?

She seems genuinely puzzled. It's only after mulling it over for a moment that she manages to piece together a clue. You gesture for her to continue, and she immediately lays out why she started using her power on her own.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: It started when my personal account received a private message from a stranger, claiming to be <color=#fb9259>Mimi-meow</color>'s manager...
Terminal or 14 Chat Frame - Web Chat

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content:
<color=#7683a2>Economics Dept. - Contact for Mimi-meow Related Matters</color>: ...It was your remarkable performance during the Phanuel incident that first caught our attention. We were absolutely delighted to discover that someone with such profound insight into the idol industry... is actually a fan of our Mimi-meow!

<color=#7683a2>Economics Dept. - Contact for Mimi-meow Related Matters</color>: As you are no doubt aware, the Phanuel incident dealt a severe blow to the idol industry, and the prejudice against us has only grown worse as a result. Our Mimi-meow, despite being a growing underground idol, has not been spared from the fallout.

<color=#7683a2>Economics Dept. - Contact for Mimi-meow Related Matters</color>: In order to counter the impact of the negative press, our company is working hard to organize promotional events for her. Our hope is that more people will come to see her dedication, and know that there are still idols out there who give their all to bring love and courage to their fans.

<color=#7683a2>Economics Dept. - Contact for Mimi-meow Related Matters</color>: If someone as prominent as yourself were willing to attend these events and show your support for Mimi-meow... it would surely help her win more hearts and become an even better idol! This is something only you can do!

<color=#7683a2>Economics Dept. - Contact for Mimi-meow Related Matters</color>: And these events will become memories that belong to you and Mimi-meow only. Surely... you wouldn't refuse, yes?

<color=#fb9259>Evie (23F, Section C, Left 07)</color>: Of course not! Oh, I mean, I'll definitely be there! Please, you have to let me be a part of this! I'll do anything if it means helping Mimi-meow!
[End of Chat Log]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I see... But as far as I can tell, he was simply looking to capitalize on the fame you gained from the Phanuel incident, no? So how did that lead to you using your power?
You skim through the invitation written with loaded language. For someone like Evie, who adores Mimi-meow, these carefully crafted words are nothing short of irresistible.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: The promotional events escalated step by step. At first, it was just solo interviews, and I'm pretty sure only underground idol fans would be able to recognize me in them. But then, a clip of me with Mimi-meow went viral out of nowhere.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Not only did I start trending, Mimi-meow's name also became one of the most searched terms! It was the first time she'd ever trended on social media. I was so...
Her eyes light up, her pale cheeks gaining a flush of color.

But the warmth doesn't brighten her sickly face so much as drain it. It's as if the excitement is burning through whatever energy is left in her. She suddenly starts swaying mid-sentence, and it takes a few seconds for her to recover.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: ...so proud. When the manager saw how well it worked, he kept at it and came up with a new plan!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I have to say, he's such a visionary! He didn't fear my power at all! If anything, he said it was perfect for promoting Mimi-meow! He said that if I used my power at Mimi-meow's live show, it would tell everyone—
Recall

steps.speaker: Melodramatic Broadcast
steps.content: Everyone, may I have your attention, please! What's <color=#fb9259>shining upon</color> Mimi-meow on stage right now isn't the venue's lights—it's the <color=#fb9259>power</color> of the one and only operator of the Mimi-meow Shrine fan account, Mimi-meow's devoted fan, Miss Evie!

steps.speaker: Melodramatic Broadcast
steps.content: It may not be the steadiest, and it may not be the brightest. But what matters is that this light shines with sincerity, and it burns with her passion. Behold! With <color=#fb9259>love</color> as <color=#fb9259>kindling</color>, even a fan can light up a stage like this, and <color=#fb9259>illuminate</color> our beloved <color=#fb9259>idol</color>!

steps.speaker: Melodramatic Broadcast
steps.content: And of course, our idol wouldn't be able to sing on this stage without the support of everyone here! Now, raise the light in your hands! Let us shine with Mimi-meow!

The crowd erupts. A wave of orange glow sticks floods the venue, and the screams nearly tear through the roof. At the edge of the side curtain, still in her business suit, the girl watches her idol, bathed in light and cheers. Her eyes slowly well up.

steps.speaker: Fans
steps.content: Mimi-meow! Mimi-meow! Mimi-meow, the sun within the night! This time, we'll light up the stage for you, Mimi-meow!
(End of Flashback)

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Sob... S-sorry, I lost my composure just now. It's just that whenever I think about how my power was able to light up Mimi-meow's stage, and even serve as a beacon for those who dedicate themselves to her... I can't hold back my tears...

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Mimi-meow and I are both so lucky to have such a dedicated team behind the scenes...! Cough, cough, as long as we keep at it, cough, cough, I know Mimi-meow will reach even greater heights and shine for even more people...!
Classic corporate nonsense. Nevertheless, Evie is eating it right up. She's been moved to tears by these memories, and even the coughing couldn't stop her from finishing her passionate speech.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, that's enough, Evie. I think I have a pretty good idea of what happened now. Including, of course, why your M-value fluctuations have been affecting your health.
You press a hand to your forehead and cut her off, giving her a chance to catch her breath before she passes out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It sounds like Mimi-meow's management knew full well that you have a full-time job, and yet they still had you skip sleep at night to use your powers for their shows. Hardly surprising that your power's been going out of control, given your body's been pushed past its limit already.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: That... can't be the only reason though. I think at least. I tend to get dizzy and cough a lot when I pull all-nighters at the office anyway. And the ringing in my ears is probably caused by the speakers at the venue being too loud...

She's still trying to swallow her discomfort and put all the blame on herself. You now realize that getting through to her will mean shifting the focus beyond herself. So, you put on a grave expression, and start to speak in a more serious tone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And I suppose violating performance regulations is perfectly normal too? Sinners are required to submit a notice before using their powers at public events or commercial shows. Any professional organizer should have reminded you to file such an application. Did they?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Huh?! There's a regulation like that...?! I'm so sorry, I had no idea... I'll make sure to check the relevant rules beforehand from now on. I won't let it happen again!
The strategy works. As expected, the term "violating regulations" would send a law-abiding soul such as her into genuine panic, so much so that her dark circles look even darker now.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I didn't realize it'd involve so much... I thought it was something I could just grit my teeth and get through, even if my body started feeling a bit off...

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I just wanted Mimi-meow to be happy... Same for her manager, her staff, everyone who loves her just like I do. As long as everyone's happy, that's all that matters. A few side effects... are nothing...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're already thinking about next time? Do you actually plan to drag yourself there in this state if they call again?

This again. The whole "I'm fine, I can hold on, what matters is that everyone else is happy" philosophy. You're a little dumbfounded at this point, and you've even started to question whether she's just pretending not to lack common sense. Still, you can't help but be a little concerned.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Evie, I'm not sure how well you understand what it means to be a Sinner, or what Mania really is. But you need to know that because of how useful your abilities can be, there will always be people looking to exploit you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even in Eastside, Mania is still a sensitive subject. If you want to keep living a normal life, that's something you'll need to be aware of. Are you... sure you haven't been taken advantage of? Has the management ever probed you in this regard?
Evie shakes her head, then hesitates and nods.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: They did want to use the story of my power awakening as promotional material, but I turned them down. I just didn't want Mimi-meow to feel bad about it if she found out. Does... that count?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The story of your power awakening?

choices.text: The story of your power awakening?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I recall correctly... You awakened your power and became a Sinner after being attacked with an unregistered, crude Mania weapon, yes? And the attacker stated that their intended target was actually the underground idol, <color=#fb9259>Mimi-meow</color>.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You were just waiting by the backstage exit when you stepped in to protect her. A commendable act, yes, but also an undeserved misfortune. You've given up so much for her... yet you insist on keeping it a secret just so she won't feel guilty?
Evie responds to your question with a simple nod, as if her quiet suffering and thankless sacrifice were too ordinary to warrant further discussion.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Is there... something wrong with that? Mimi-meow is such a kind person. If she ever found out, she'd definitely feel terrible! The last thing I want is to make her doubt whether she should keep being an idol because of this!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Her performance saved me once... so I know just how much her existence means. I just want her to keep doing what she does on that stage... She doesn't need to concern herself, cough cough, with these little things.

Evie drops her gaze, lost in memory, a warm and bashful smile tugging at the corners of her mouth. She lingers in the sweetness of it, utterly unconcerned with the danger she's in or what she stands to lose, never once stopping to ask herself whether any of this is right.

Getting infected with Mania and becoming a Sinner to save her idol, running her body into the ground doing promotional work for her idol... These are "little things," according to her. Is nothing a big deal to this girl, as long as it means wearing herself down for someone else's sake?
Just what has she been through to become like this? And what would it even take to pull her out of this dangerous tendency of sacrificing herself?

You are no savior, and you cannot fix everything. But as the Chief of MBCC, you have a responsibility to make sure the person in front of you never again falls into the abyss of Mania, simply because she's <color=#fb9259>giving too much of herself</color>.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And what does your family think about this "little thing"? Even if they don't expect some kind of repayment, surely they'd at least want Mimi-meow to know what happened and be grateful?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: My family? You mean... my parents? Well... actually, they don't even know I'm a Sinner...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You never told them? Why not? Did you decide to shoulder everything alone so you wouldn't worry them?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Well... that's part of it. But... It's also because I can still go to work and live my life normally, even though I've become a Sinner. I haven't caused too much trouble for anyone, so...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not worried about you causing trouble for others, Evie. I'm worried about you. You're always thinking about others, afraid of burdening them. But what about you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's true that unless a Sinner is a minor, the Bureau doesn't notify their family. But that policy exists to protect privacy, not to force you to fight alone. Have you ever considered that your way of thinking is what's causing your body to fall apart?

The words seem to touch on something Evie never even considered. She freezes, her expression going blank, and it takes a long moment before she finally processes things and manages to mutter out an uncertain response.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Is it...? But... <color=#fb9259>that's</color> just how it always is at home...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>That</color>?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: It's nothing special, really. My family is... pretty ordinary. My father had a pretty high salary, but he was always busy. He'd come home late, or sometimes not at all. And on the rare occasions he did come home, he never liked hearing about household troubles or anything unpleasant.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: My mother cared deeply for my father, and her mood was easily affected by him. I couldn't be a substitute for my father, so I just... did what I could. At the very least, I didn't want to make things harder for her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Harder?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Yes. Every day, my mother would sit in the living room, waiting for my father. Sometimes she'd sit there all night. She'd say it was fine, that he was doing it all for the family. But I could tell she was really sad when he didn't come home. She wanted someone to be there for her.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: So I'd talk with her, get water for her, and remind her to go to bed soon. I kept whatever was going on at school to myself so I wouldn't worry her. Sometimes, she'd pat me on the head and say she was glad to have such a sensible child. That made me really happy.
She smiles as she talks. Yet, all you can see is a young Evie learning to be her mother's emotional anchor, giving more and more of herself just to earn a small measure of her mother's attention.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: As long as I pay a little more attention to how everyone's feeling and try a little harder, I can make the people around me happy. And when they're happy, I'm happy too. What's... wrong with that?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is that something your mother taught you?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Well... she'd just say that a little discomfort was no big deal. That as long as she <color=#fb9259>gave</color> enough, my father would notice her efforts, and he'd repay her with an equal amount of <color=#fb9259>love</color>.

The logic behind her self-destruction finally becomes clear. She pushes past the damage to her body and keeps on <color=#fb9259>giving</color> because she believes it's the only way to earn what she calls <color=#fb9259>love</color>.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Which is why you don't know how to say no, why you give without keeping score, and why you keep pushing. But the logic doesn't hold, does it? If those who give are truly always compensated in full, you wouldn't need some idol to be your anchor, would you? Nor would you be looking for something more.
Your question cuts straight to the heart of it, yet she doesn't flinch or falter. Evie simply looks back at you, genuinely puzzled.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: That's just... normal, isn't it? You have to give to receive. That's just... how life is. I might be tired, but all I need is to find something that'll keep me going for a little longer and help me push through.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: My dad, my mom, my boss, my coworkers... they all work hard. They're all doing their best. I'm not special or anything.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: If someone has something come up, or someone's not feeling well, I'll pick up the slack and handle a bit more work at night... That's all perfectly normal. Sometimes, people even thank me when they notice I'm working overtime!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: If anyone has it hard... it's Mimi-meow. She's the one who showed me that even when you're struggling, you can still shine and illuminate the people around you!
The moment Mimi-meow's name comes up, her gaze drifts somewhere distant, and her voice becomes much more lively.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Without her, I don't know if I'd have made it this far! I still remember the first time I went to her live show. I was so exhausted I could barely lift my head, but she still drew me in!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: It was winter, and she was out on the street doing promotions in a little skirt. She must have been freezing, but she still noticed how tired I was. She asked if I was doing okay, and if she could sing me a song to cheer me up.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Yes! And that's how I found my sun! The stage was tiny, the crowd was small, even the glow sticks were freebies. But she sang with everything she had regardless, and every time we awkwardly waved our arms, she'd break into the most radiant smile!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: That's when I thought—this must be what my mom was talking about! She keeps shining and radiating warmth, even when she's struggling herself. She's someone who earned her happiness by <color=#fb9259>giving</color>... cough cough cough!

The coughing hits her without warning, perhaps because she was getting too excited. She doubles over, struggling to catch her breath, yet still fights to compose herself so that she can get across all the emotions welling up inside her.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: And that's how I came to be her fan. She's the star that lights up my life! I want her to stand on a bigger, brighter stage, so that everyone can see her shine!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: If you'd seen her live, you'd understand! Mimi-meow is genuinely worth it. She's not the kind of idol who's only in it for the fame. She takes her work seriously, she's gentle, she remembers anything the fans have said to her, and she even reminds everyone not to stay up all night voting for her!
She looks at you with something close to reverence, her eyes bright and glimmering. The timid Sinner who shuffled into the interrogation room moments ago is nowhere to be seen now.

You can tell Evie genuinely sees Mimi-meow for who she is, rather than a commodity to be consumed. More importantly, if Mimi-meow truly is everything Evie says she is, then it might just be the key to bringing her back down to earth.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Doesn't sound like Mimi-meow would approve of what you're doing then.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If she's someone who'd remind her fans not to stay up all night voting for her, I'd say she'd be anything but happy knowing you're working all day before heading to events at night, and constantly using your power. Wouldn't you agree?
A flicker of doubt crosses Evie's face, but she quickly finds a refutation, stumbling over her words as she speaks up.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: But I'm doing this so more people can see her! Mimi-meow always says she wants to bring <color=#fb9259>love</color> and courage to as many people as possible. If my efforts can make that happen a little sooner, she'll definitely... cough cough, she'll definitely understand!
And there it is again, the self-sacrifice theory that Evie keeps using to justify her recklessness. It seems there's little hope of digging any deeper before you break this loop.
So you let it go for now. You'll likely need to pay a visit to this little idol, who might just be able to help you progress.
Whether she truly is as flawless as Evie makes her out to be, or simply another Phanuel hiding behind a perfect mask.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright. Let's just say Mimi-meow would understand. Still, the Bureau has an obligation to prevent Mania outbreaks, and I can't stand by while you keep using your power in your current condition.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll need you to resubmit the application for every time you've used your powers without authorization. On top of that, you'll need to sign a written declaration that this won't happen again. Any objections?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: No, but... I mean, could I...

With your conclusions drawn and your approach set, the interrogation is coming to an end. However, Evie doesn't comply as readily as you'd expected. Instead, she squirms and makes a rather presumptuous request.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Could you give me just one last chance...? There's a <color=#fb9259>special live show</color> the day after tomorrow. It means a lot to Mimi-meow and us fans, and I already promised I'd be there to <color=#fb9259>work as the lights</color>...

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I know it's against the rules, but... what if I filed an application right now? If that's still not okay... could I ask you to come supervise in person? I know you're busy, but this really means a lot to me. I promise it won't take up too much of your time...
She peeks at you through her hair, like a puppy that's gauging its owner's mood.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I thought I made it clear that your power is taking a toll on your body?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: The thing is, it's a big day for Mimi-meow, and I've put together a special celebration event... If I, the organizer, suddenly don't show up, everyone will be left in a bind, and it might affect Mimi-meow too...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let me check my schedule first. I've been pretty busy lately.
If it means that much to you, sure.

choices.text: Let me check my schedule first. I've been pretty busy lately.
If it means that much to you, sure.

steps.content: Option 1

You look down to open your schedule, acting like you're hesitant. You haven't looked once during that time, yet you can practically feel Evie's gaze burning into your terminal, equal parts hope and prayer.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're lucky. Things aren't too hectic right now. Underground idol shows are usually in the evenings, right? I should be able to afford to keep one night open.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll come with you, but not as a supervisor. The shackles can help offset the burden of using your special power. Think of me as a field medic sent by the medical department.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I-is that really okay?! Are you sure it's not too much trouble? Wait, do I, cough cough cough, need to do some kind of test? It's okay, just treat me like a lab rat! Thank you, I really mean it, thank you so much!

Evie's distress melts away at your words. She's coughing up a storm and practically beside herself with joy, so much so that she doesn't know what to do with her hands or feet. You can't help but shake your head with a smile.
Of course, you have no plans to use her as a "lab rat" for anything. You're heading there to meet a certain someone. But if it puts her at ease, maybe it's a good thing.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I'll put together everything for you in advance! The time, location, schedule, and the manager's contact info. I'll also send over a starter playlist for getting into Mimi-meow... Oh, sorry, that last part... probably has nothing to do with the approval process, does it?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Feel free to attach it for now.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: O-okay!

She finally lets out a smile that's genuinely relaxed, her fan merchandise swaying softly with the movement. But all that color and brightness can't hide the pallor on her face or the dark circles under her eyes.

Then let's see if the "center of her world" can help you treat both the symptoms and the cause. Let's see if she can stabilize this dim star that's always on the verge of <color=#fb9259>burning out</color>.
